# saas-django-backend

> A security-first, LGPD-aware Django 6.1 foundation for a multi-tenant SaaS. One function declared with @action is a REST endpoint, an MCP tool, a Temporal activity and a CLI command at once.

Read AGENTS.md first: it holds the rules, the commands and the definition of done. The links below are repository paths.

## Agents

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): rules, commands, LGPD decision tree, definition of done
- [docs/reference/conventions.json](docs/reference/conventions.json): the same, as data
- [docs/reference/actions.json](docs/reference/actions.json): every action, scope and schema

## Start here

- [Platform documentation](docs/en/index.md): A Django 6 base for multi-tenant systems of any kind. One function you write becomes a REST
- [Quickstart](docs/en/quickstart.md): Requirements: Python 3.12+, uv. Docker is optional.
- [Architecture](docs/en/architecture.md): Proxy/ingress (TLS) → gunicorn with uvicorn workers → `BodyLimit` ASGI middleware (size and

## Security

- [Audit integrity](docs/en/security/audit-integrity.md): Each organization (plus one system chain) has its own hash chain. A row stores an **HMAC** of the
- [Builder's checklist: security and LGPD for every change](docs/en/security/builder-checklist.md): Run through the section that matches what you are adding. Each line says what to do and what
- [Hardening and key management](docs/en/security/hardening.md): HTTPS redirect (health probes exempt), HSTS, secure/HTTP-only/SameSite cookies, a `'self'`-only CSP
- [Security review](docs/en/security/review.md): Status of the review of this template. Update this page whenever you change authentication,
- [Threat model](docs/en/security/threat-model.md): Out of scope: a compromised host or build pipeline, malicious superusers who also hold the keys

## Lgpd

- [LGPD compliance matrix](docs/en/lgpd/compliance-matrix.md): Article → platform feature → code → test. "Operator" means the organization running the system
- [LGPD (Brazilian data protection) overview](docs/en/lgpd/overview.md): LGPD art. 14 requires a parent's or guardian's specific consent for a child's data. The ECA Digital
- [LGPD document templates](docs/en/lgpd/templates.md): Starting points for the documents the LGPD asks you to have. **They are templates, not legal
